card.name: Lab assay and test-method wording
card.fires_on: Words inside or just before names of lab tests and assay methods, such as immunoassay, enzymatic test, or chromatography, mostly in drug-interaction or false-positive test notes.

modes.label: Inside assay names
modes.description: Partway through a lab test word like immunoassay or enzymatic.
modes.example: False-positive urine imm<<uno>>assay screening tests for phencyclid

modes.label: Linking words before methods
modes.description: Words like 'such as' or 'include' that lead into a list of confirmatory methods.
modes.example: Confirmatory tests, such<< as>> gas chromatography/mass spectrometry

modes.label: Inside other list words
modes.description: Partway through a word in a list of products to avoid, such as peeling agents.
